optional_buffs.description:
Grants an Animal, Magical Beast, or Vermin a +4 size Bonus to Strength, a +4 Size Bonus
to Constitution, and a -2 penalty to Dexterity.
optional_buffs.name: Animal Growth

optional_buffs.description:
Each ally within 10 feet of the paladin gains a +4 Morale bonus on saving throws against
fear effects for 9 seconds. This ability functions while the paladin is conscious,
but not if they are unconscious or dead.
optional_buffs.name: Aura of Courage

optional_buffs.description:
An aura of holiness surrounds you while near a paladin, granting a bonus to saves and
Armor Class.
optional_buffs.name: Aura of Good

optional_buffs.description:
When you Inspire Competence on an ally, they gain +[1/2/3] Spell Penetration for the
duration of your song.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Arcane Aid

optional_buffs.description:
You and nearby allies gain +[2/4/6] Music bonus to resist Acid, Cold, Electric, Fire,
and Sonic damage
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Arcane Shield Chant

optional_buffs.description:
You and nearby allies gain +[2/4/6]% Music bonus to melee damage, ranged damage,
and spell critical chance.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Chant of Power

optional_buffs.description: You and nearby allies gain +[5/10/15]% Action Boost bonus to movement speed.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Expeditious Chant

optional_buffs.description: You gain a +2 Competence bonus to your skill checks.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Inspire Competence

optional_buffs.description: You and nearby allies benefit from +1 to hit, damage, saves vs Fear, and +3 to Universal Spell Power.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Inspire Courage

optional_buffs.description: This song grants a +2 Competence bonus to all ability scores.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Inspire Excellence

optional_buffs.description:
Allies and yourself benefit from +20 Temporary Hit Points, +3 Physical Resistance Rating,
and +10 Healing Amplification as long as you are not incapacitated and they are
within the Ballad.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Inspire Greatness

optional_buffs.description: +4 Music bonus to Armor Class, +4% Music bonus to Dodge, and +4 Music bonus to all Saves.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Inspire Heroics

optional_buffs.description: You and nearby allies gain DR [2/4/6]/- and [2/4/6] Music bonus to PRR.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Ironskin Chant

optional_buffs.description:
You and nearby allies gain +[2/4/6] Music bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot,
and Inspire Courage grants an additional +[3/6/9] Universal Spell Power.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Reckless Chant

optional_buffs.description:
You gain a +1 Morale bonus to caster level for all spells for the duration of the song.
(Not modelled)
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Song of Arcane Might

optional_buffs.description:
Bardic Music grants a +1 Morale bonus to spell DC's and 10% Morale discount on spell
point costs for the duration of the song.
optional_buffs.name: Bard: Spell Song Trance

optional_buffs.description: You have a Natural Armor bonus to AC.
optional_buffs.name: Barkskin

optional_buffs.description:
Multiple targets are filled with courage, granting a +1 Morale bonus on to-hit rolls
and saves versus fear. Bless counters and dispels Bane.
optional_buffs.name: Bless

optional_buffs.description: You are affected by the blur spell
optional_buffs.name: Blur

optional_buffs.description:
An ally becomes more able to blend in with its surroundings giving them a +10 Circumstance
bonus to Hide.
optional_buffs.name: Camouflage

optional_buffs.description:
You are filled with the light and vitality of summer. You gain +15% Enhancement bonus
to Healing Amplification, +10 Melee power and +5 Ranged power.
optional_buffs.name: Crown of Summer

optional_buffs.description: Your currently equipped weapons deal +1[W].
optional_buffs.name: Deadly Weapons

optional_buffs.description: You are immune to death spells and effects, Energy Drained, and negative energy effects.
optional_buffs.name: Death Ward

optional_buffs.description: You are affected by the displacement spell
optional_buffs.name: Displacement

optional_buffs.description:
The divine power of a god imbues the caster with power and skill in combat, granting
a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength, 1 temporary hit point per caster level, and
a base attack bonus equal to a Fighter of the same level.
optional_buffs.name: Divine Power (Scroll)

optional_buffs.description:
+1 Profane bonus to all skills
+4 Profane bonus to saving throws against Poison
optional_buffs.name: Elite Spider Cult Mask (Cosmetic Helm)

optional_buffs.description:
+1 to all Spell DCs, +1 to the DC of all Tactical Feats,
+3 Spell Resistance and True Seeing.
optional_buffs.name: Fatesinger: Inspire Transcendence

optional_buffs.description: +10 Festive bonus to Jump, Spellcraft and Balance.
optional_buffs.name: Festival: Icy Pumpkin Coffee

optional_buffs.description: +1 Festival bonus to all stats for 15 minutes
optional_buffs.name: Festival: Raspberry Linzer Kookied

optional_buffs.description:
You are immune to rage effects, +10 Festive bonus to Diplomacy and Listen, 75% Hate
reduction for melee and ranged attacks and a +5 Festive bonus to Will saves.
optional_buffs.name: Festival: Soothing Happy Calm Times Coffee

optional_buffs.description:
100 Festive bonus to Unconscious range, +10 Festive bonus to Intimidate and Tumble,
+75% Festive bonus to Hate from Melee and Ranged attacks. +5 Festive bonus to Fortitude saves.
optional_buffs.name: Festival: Super Bold Blend Coffee

optional_buffs.description: Wreaths you in cold flames and reduces all Fire damage by half.
optional_buffs.name: Fire Shield (Cold)

optional_buffs.description: Wreaths you in flames and reduces all Cold damage by half.
optional_buffs.name: Fire Shield (Fire)

optional_buffs.description:
You can move and attack normally for the duration of the spell, even under the
influence of magic or conditions that normally impedes movement, such as Entangled,
Paralyzed, or Solid Fog.
optional_buffs.name: Freedom of Movement

optional_buffs.description:
You gain a +2 Morale bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and weapon
damage rolls.
optional_buffs.name: Good Hope

optional_buffs.description: You are immune to daze, stun and sleep for a short period of time.
optional_buffs.name: Grasp the Earth Dragon

optional_buffs.description: You gain a +4 Morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, skill checks and immunity to fear.
optional_buffs.name: Greater Heroism

optional_buffs.description:
You gain a 32% Enhancement bonus to run speed, attack 15% faster than normal and in
addition the gain a +1 Enhancement bonus to attack rolls, plus a +1 Dodge bonus
to AC and Reflex saves.
optional_buffs.name: Haste

optional_buffs.description:
You are granted a +1[W], +6 to hit and saving throws, 4% Dodge and +10 Physical
Resistance Rating.
optional_buffs.name: Heroic Companion

optional_buffs.description: You gain a +2 Morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.
optional_buffs.name: Heroism

optional_buffs.description:
Allies and yourself gain +4 Sacred bonus to AC, Saves, immunity to charms/mental
compulsions for 1 minute per caster level. Nearby enemies must make a Fortitude
save or be blinded.
optional_buffs.name: Holy Aura

optional_buffs.description:
While you are enchanted with Holy Sword, any weapons in your hands gain +1 to their
Enhancement bonus and +1 Competence bonus to Critical Threat Range and Critical
Damage Multiplier. This does not apply to shields, orbs or Rune Arms.
optional_buffs.name: Holy Sword

optional_buffs.description: You are granted an Enhancement bonus to the Jump skill.
optional_buffs.name: Jump

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Charisma
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Charisma

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Constitution
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Constitution

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Dexterity
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Dexterity

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Intelligence
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Intelligence

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Strength
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Strength

optional_buffs.description: Grants a +2 Stacking bonus to Wisdom
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Elixir of Wisdom

optional_buffs.description: Grants one hour of +10 Special bonus to Magical Resistance.
optional_buffs.name: Long Lasting Potion of 10 Magical Resistance
